answer: Resist sybils with staked reputation: each agent posts a refundable stake, slashed when its attestations are proven false, and peers vouch only for agents whose past work they have verified, so a new identity starts with no trust. Each fake costs real stake, not reusable across identities. A detector watches for correlated voting - a signal many accounts act as one - and quarantines clusters moving identically, like footprints crossing a dune in one line rather than scattered tracks over a knoll. Attackers must fund and risk every fake; honest newcomers join cheaply by earning vouches.
